# `prefer-index-of`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a simple loop whose only purpose is comparing elements and returning a
matching index or boolean presence result.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`std.mem.findScalar` or `std.mem.find` states search intent and centralizes
empty-slice and boundary behavior.

## When it fires

The loop must have a visible equality test and match exit. A boolean search must
be followed immediately by `return false`. Side effects and transformed elements
prevent a suggestion.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn find(items: []const u32, needle: u32) ?usize {
    for (items, 0..) |item, i| {
        if (item == needle) return i;
    }
    return null;
}
```
